factor_name: DXY Five-Day Shock Conditioned Three-Day Cross-Asset Reversal

calculation.expression: if lagged(5d_log_change(DXY)) > rolling_252_quantile(5d_log_change(DXY), 0.75), then -3d_log_return(asset), cross_sectionally demeaned by median
calculation.description: Activates a cross-asset three-day reversal signal after an unusually large five-day DXY move. DXY is observation-only and is never traded; signals are generated only for the 15 tradable benchmark instruments. The activation is lagged one completed observation to avoid look-ahead.

validation.sample_interpretation: Passes benchmark daily IC and ICIR gates on 107 qualifying dates with approximately 14 instruments per date. Regime behavior is mixed in 2023-2024 and the 2027 YTD estimate is very uncertain due to only 10 observations.
